column1: # script-VM object reference accessors - EC-7 family C, declared on phyre-script-object-accessors.md
# PROVED BY INSTRUCTION FORM, NOT BY BYTES, and that is a weaker claim stated as one.
# A byte comparison reports 264 distinct images because each accessor carries
# its own FIELD OFFSET. Comparing decoded instruction forms with constants dropped
# collapses the group to TWO forms, matching its two body sizes: 249 B (160) and 282 B (104),
# Control (external call/jmp targets only, intra-body branches excluded):
#   00812960 x528, 00682980 x264, 00811130 x264 and 0063BC00 x264 - one at exactly TWICE the member count and three at exactly ONCE.
# WHAT VARIES between two members of the SAME form is the field offset and the type
# descriptor address. A form match is evidence of a shared SHAPE - it is NOT evidence
# that the differing constants do not matter, and here they are the whole payload.
# NOT dispositioned: the four shared implementations, and whatever field each accessor
# One function entry address per line, VA (image base 0x00120000 included).
